description: Get every page of a Doc together with its full content (ClickUp Docs v3). Returns content as markdown by default. Use to read an entire Doc at once.

content_format.description: Format to return page content in: 'text/md' (default) or 'text/html'.

doc_id.description: ID of the Doc whose pages to fetch.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_doc_pages
